svg.title: Offline validation, packaging, hosted checks, and deployment gates
svg.desc: The offline runner records tests, probes, demos, and synthetic GraphRAG checks. CI also installs the package. Optional legacy compatibility, experimental preservation, and deployment qualification remain distinct gates; a passing offline report does not authorize production.
